task.title: Acknowledge an alert
task.shortdesc: Record that you reviewed an alert, so that other operators know it is handled.

prereq.p: You are signed in to the dashboard.

context.p: Acknowledge an alert only after you have reviewed the device that raised it. The acknowledgement records your client ID and the time.
context.note: As an administrator, you can also delete a device that keeps raising alerts and has been retired. Deleting a device deletes its alerts.

step.stepresult: The Alerts table shows the latest alerts.

step.cmd: In the Alerts table, find the alert and read its severity, device and message.
In the Devices table, select the device and review its latest readings.
step.info: A vibration value above is shown in red.

step.cmd: In the alert row, select Acknowledge.
step.stepresult: A green message confirms the acknowledgement.

result.p: The alert state changes to acknowledged. The row shows your client ID, and the Open alerts counter decreases by one.

postreq.p: If new alerts keep arriving for the same device, set its status to maintenance while you investigate.
